mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_id AS userId, type, title, message, link, read_yn AS readYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(tenant_id, user_id, type, title, message, link) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{message}, #{link})
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_yn = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = FALSE
